     Stipulation in Lieu of Cross-Examination
                      Between
  Schwertner Farms, Inc., Solana Intervenors, and
             Brady Creek Intervenors

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

        COMES NOW Schwertner Farms, Inc., the Solana Intervenors, and Brady
Creek/Wolf Bluff Intervenors (Brady Creek Intervenors), and offer the following
stipulation in lieu of the cross-examination of witness James Schwertner:

       Stipulations

       In lieu of cross, if crossed, Mr. James Schwertner, Schwertner Farms, Inc.,
would have testified to the following effect:

        “As stated in my direct testimony, my primary concern is that the project not
utilize Link E2. Link E2 presents unique and long-term conflicts that do not exist on
some other links.



                                          1 of 3
        Route 392 does not utilize Link E2.

       As stated in my direct testimony, Links E2, E4, E51, and F01 would create the
greatest conflicts with Schwertner Farms' properties and long term land use plans.

       Route 392 does not utilize Links E2, E4, E51, or F01.

       Route 392 does not cross any property owned by Schwertner Farms, Inc. or by any
other Schwertner family entity or individual.”

       On redirect, Mr. Schwertner would have testified to the following effect:

       “I do not support Route 392.

        My direct testimony addressed the links and routes that most directly affect the
properties Schwertner Farms, Inc. owns. The fact that Route 392 avoids those particular
links and that property does not mean I support it.

      I do support Route 894, which does not affect the family of my lifelong friend
Glenn Hodge.”

                                        Respectfully submitted,
